_comment: Pinned upstream dependencies, and what has to be true before one of them moves. Read by `bun run check:upstream-pins` and by the `upstream-pin-watch` / `upstream-version-adoption` processes under processes/. NOTE WHAT IS NOT HERE: the pinned version. It lives in the file the build reads, and `pinnedIn` + `pattern` say how to read it from there — a registry with its own copy would be a second answer to "what are we running", free to disagree with the build.

pins.title: just-the-docs Jekyll theme
binds: docs/assets/js/docs-ui.js — MOVES the theme's own search markup into the action launcher; binds `.search`, `#search-input`, `.search-label`. An upstream rename degrades a shipped feature without failing the build.
docs/assets/css/docs-ui.css — overrides `.side-bar`, `.site-header`, `.main-header`; `sidebar-panels.e2e.ts` records that the theme hard-caps `.site-header` height.
test/a11y.e2e.ts — fixtures reproduce the theme's own search markup, including that the accessible name comes from `<label for=search-input>` rather than an aria-label.
test/action-tiles.e2e.ts — asserts the theme's search element as rendered into `.main-header`.
test/sidebar-panels.e2e.ts — asserts the theme's sidebar column and capped header.
docs/_includes/head_custom.html — pulled into every page by the theme.
docs/_config.yml — `search_enabled`, `heading_anchors`, `color_scheme: dark`, `mermaid`, `keep_files`, `footer_content` are all theme options.

pins.title: Bun runtime
binds: Every `.github/workflows/*.yml` — 22 `oven-sh/setup-bun@v2` sites carry `bun-version` literals, and `check:bun-pin` fails if any disagrees with `.bun-version`. That gate is what makes this ONE answer rather than 23: without it the copies would be free to disagree, which is exactly what this registry's own note forbids.

cat-harness/content/pipeline/qa-utils.ts — `saveQaScriptSidecar` skips the write unless a substantive field moved, and `engine_version` (`bun-${Bun.version}`) is one of them. An unpinned runtime therefore rewrites every script sidecar whenever the engine differs, which took `bun run gates`' tree-mutation detector to 'NOT clean' on every branch including pristine main (bean `3ozg`).

cat-harness/content/pipeline/script-sidecars/*.script.json — 86 committed records whose `engine_version` is this pin's observable consequence. They held TWO values when the pin was added: 72 at bun-1.3.14 and 14 at bun-1.3.11.
